parsed.rationale: All three members — `MaterialBlendModeKey`, `OverlayBlendModeKey`, and `PlaybackBlendModeKey` — are `type-alias-object` declarations at exactly line 89 in three parallel files within the same `Wallpaper` package, with identical structure (`shared_field_count: 1`, no differing slots). The only distinction is the domain-concept prefix (Material, Overlay, Playback), which is a strong signal that a single generic `BlendModeKey<BlendMode>` type parameterised on the blend-mode kind would unify all three without loss of type safety. Because all three live in `Shared/Wallpaper/Sources/Wallpaper/Core/`, a new file such as `BlendModeKey.swift` in that same directory is the natural home, and the three existing type aliases can be reduced to `typealias MaterialBlendModeKey = BlendModeKey<MaterialBlendMode>` etc., or removed entirely if call sites are updated.
